provenance.source: PR #11225 fix(xhr): remove progress event listeners on request completion, squash-merged 2026-10-15 as b16dd7787
provenance.note: Clean control: the XHR adapter now detaches its download and upload progress listeners in `done()`, reporting a throwing final progress callback asynchronously and skipping the detach when a flush already re-entered completion. Checked in the clone at 530adb0aa: `git rev-list b16dd7787..HEAD -- lib/adapters/xhr.js tests/browser/progress.browser.test.js tests/unit/adapters/xhr.test.js` is empty and each of those files' last commit is b16dd7787 itself, so no later fix or revert can reach a line the PR added. Only PRE_RELEASE_CHANGELOG.md moved afterwards, and no commit reverts or re-references #11225.
